The test image shows a corn leaf with:
- Dense, small black circular dots scattered across the leaf surface
- Yellow to tan discoloration in patches
- Some larger brownish-gray necrotic areas
- Dots appear embedded/raised in the leaf tissue

This pattern strongly suggests Tar Spot (black glossy stromata on leaves). Let me confirm with one reference image.

The reference image matches the test image very well: identical small, black, circular/oval raised stromata (tar spot) scattered across the corn leaf surface. The test image simply shows a more advanced/severe case with additional yellowing and larger necrotic areas from coalescing lesions — consistent with the Tar Spot description of "necrotic halos coalescing causing leaf blight and premature senescence."
